feeds.title: Rebuilding Malaysia
feeds.description: Welcome to mariammokhtar.com. Like you, I am an ordinary member of the Malaysian rakyat and I am concerned about many disturbing social, economic and political developments in Malaysia. Umno-Baru politicians use meaningless, slogans that are created by public relations companies and paid for by the taxpayer. This site hopes to unmask them and expose them for what they really are.
